description: Key facts a correct lesson on each VLSI Design Basics topic must state. Every fact was taken from the fetched text of the source page named with it (the quote is checked by `npm run golden:check`). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the lesson text after LaTeX backslashes and braces are removed.
subject: vlsi

facts.claim: Gate voltage controls conductivity (insulated gate)

source.quote: It has an insulated gate, the voltage of which determines the conductivity of the device

facts.claim: An inversion layer forms a channel between source and drain

source.quote: creates an inversion layer or channel

facts.claim: CMOS uses complementary pairs of p- and n-type MOSFETs

source.quote: uses complementary and sy

facts.claim: An inverter outputs the opposite bit

source.quote: It outputs a bit whose value is opposite of the input bit's value

facts.claim: CMOS has low static power

source.quote: low static power consumption

facts.claim: Power is drawn mainly while switching

source.quote: draws significant power only momentarily during switching between on and off states

facts.claim: Layout = planar geometric shapes for the chip's layers

source.quote: is the representation of an integrated circuit in terms of planar geometric shapes

facts.claim: CMOS has no standing current (unlike NMOS logic)

source.quote: is called the setup phase or the precharge phase, and the second phase, when Clock is high, is called the evaluation phase

source.quote: Two major hardware description languages exist: VHDL and Verilog

facts.claim: HDLs allow automated analysis and simulation

source.quote: allows for the automated analysis and simulation of the circuit
